data.name: Frontline 1944
data.detailed_description:
Frontline 1944 is a World War II tactical shooter built around gritty infantry combat, battlefield pressure, and mission-based frontline warfare.

Step into the role of a soldier during one of the most brutal periods of the war. Fight through ruined villages, open fields, fog-covered roads, trenches, defensive positions, and enemy-held zones. Every mission puts you close to the action, where gunfire, explosions, smoke, and limited visibility make each advance feel tense.

The game focuses on grounded combat rather than arcade-style action. Players must move carefully, use cover, watch enemy positions, and work through each objective with patience. Rushing into open ground can get you killed quickly. Surviving the battlefield means choosing when to push, when to hold, and when to reposition.

Use World War II era weapons and equipment across different combat situations. Engage enemy soldiers at range, clear dangerous areas, support squad movement, and take part in larger battlefield moments with vehicles, artillery fire, and heavy resistance depending on the mission.

Frontline 1944 is designed for players who enjoy realistic war atmosphere, tactical movement, and intense frontline combat.

Features:

Realistic World War II inspired battlefield environments

Mission-based tactical shooter gameplay

Infantry combat with period weapons

Foggy skies, smoke, explosions, and war-torn locations

Squad-based battlefield movement

Enemy soldiers, defensive positions, and combat objectives

Large outdoor combat zones with ruins, roads, trenches, and open terrain

A serious military tone focused on survival and frontline pressure

The battlefield is dangerous, the visibility is low, and every step forward matters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060 / AMD equivalent or better
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 3060 / AMD equivalent or better
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains World War II themed combat, including military weapons, gunfire, explosions, battlefield destruction, and scenes of soldiers fighting in realistic war environments. Players may see violence related to shooting, combat missions, and enemy encounters. The game may include mild blood effects and dead or injured soldiers depending on the scene.

The game does not include sexual content, sexual assault, nudity, drug abuse, alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
